summary: Sandbach United faced local rivals Alsager in the Macron Cup 1st Round at Hind Heath Road, with Matty Birchall returning to the squad and Callum Bedford making his debut in the matchday 16. Joe Bevan continues to be a key player for the club, currently sitting sixth in the NWCFL goalscoring charts with 135 goals this season. The Bach will be looking to progress through the cup competition in what promises to be an intense local derby.
